articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones attack Russia’s Black Sea coast, sparking a fire at an oil depot
articles.lead_en: A Ukrainian drone attack on the city of Sochi and the nearby town of Sirius sparked a fire overnight on September 4 at an oil depot, according to the Krasnodar Krai Operational Headquarters.
